# Velair 1.9.3-beta.4

This beta adds an optional Room Assist control margin and improves Boost returns to Keep current mode.

## ✨ Added

- **Minimum control margin** helps thermostats that need a larger gap between their internal reading and requested setpoint to respond. Fixed Heat/Cool can strengthen both demand and withdrawal; automatic modes retain neutral holding and ranges preserve their width. The margin defaults to **0**, is validated against Maximum assist delta, and includes localized contextual help and limitation reporting. ([#73](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/73))

## 🛠️ Fixed

- When Boost expires or is cancelled into **Keep current mode**, Velair applies the current block's temperature or range using the pre-Boost HVAC mode, preserving device presets. An interrupted return can finish after Home Assistant restarts, independently of the normal schedule-on-startup setting. ([#63](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/63))

## 🧭 Notes

- This prerelease follows [1.9.3-beta.3](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/releases/tag/v1.9.3-beta.3).
- Older supported backups remain importable. New exports require a compatible Velair version; keep a pre-update backup if you might need to downgrade.
- After updating through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the browser or Companion app.
